title: Ripple
subtitle: Research that remembers why—and knows when to recheck.

slides.title: A concrete user problem
bullets: Research decisions outlive the facts they depend on.
Create your own source-backed board, not just run a preset demo.
slides.notes: Show the actual app and the specific target user.

slides.title: The search mechanism
bullets: Answer-level dependency invalidation and selective revalidation.
Telem retrieves the evidence; the app makes the domain decision.
slides.notes: Explain the real implementation, not provider internals.

slides.title: Try to break the conclusion
bullets: Edit a requirement, then inspect affected and preserved answers.
Save, reload and refresh actual source evidence.
slides.notes: Keep live, cached and synthetic runs visibly distinct.

slides.title: Evidence, not a promised score
bullets: Present actual baseline and treatment observations.
Report sample count, failures and limitations.
slides.notes: Until measured, state not measured. Never insert planned targets as results.

slides.title: A scoped product with a next step
bullets: Public technical-documentation beta; browser-local boards and bounded shared usage.
No cloud sync, automatic monitoring or guarantee that every dependency is discovered.
slides.notes: Use the actual hosted URL in the final deck after deployment.
